security_opt.description: security_opt for every container of this environment (stock Docker defaults if empty).
security_opt.title: Security Opt

bwrap_security_opt.description:
Extra relaxations added only for cells whose harness uses the bwrap inner sandbox.

bwrap creates user namespaces (blocked by Docker's default seccomp profile) and mounts
a fresh /proc (refused while Docker masks /proc paths). Cost: inside those containers,
root can write global /proc/sys entries (e.g. kernel.core_pattern) and
/proc/sysrq-trigger, and every user can create user namespaces. That is why scorers
never run agent-written code as root, and why a gVisor (``runsc``) runtime is the
better choice for bwrap cells on a shared Docker host.
bwrap_security_opt.title: Bwrap Security Opt

cpus.description: CPU limit in cores, fractions allowed (e.g. 1.5); ``None`` = no limit.
cpus.title: Cpus

pids_limit.description: Per-container process limit, so one sample cannot exhaust the Docker VM.
pids_limit.title: Pids Limit

internet_target.description: host:port used by the outbound-internet containment check (TCP connect only).
internet_target.title: Internet Target

host_ports.description:
Ports tried on the default gateway (the VM host) by the host-reachability check.

5000/7000 are macOS AirPlay receiver listeners, open by default on most Macs.
host_ports.title: Host Ports

SbxSettings.description:
Docker Sandboxes (``sbx``): one microVM per sample, from a Docker image loaded as a
sandbox template by ``agenteval env build``.

image.description: Docker image built from ``provision/Dockerfile`` (the one docker-ubuntu uses).
image.title: Image

template.description:
What sandboxes start from: ``image`` plus the label that gives root in the sandbox
its full capabilities (the egress rule needs CAP_NET_ADMIN), loaded with
``sbx template load``.
template.title: Template

cpus.description: vCPUs per sandbox (None: sbx's default, every host CPU).
cpus.title: Cpus

SbxSettings.title: SbxSettings

image.description: Local Tart VM built by ``agenteval env build``; cloned for every sample.
image.title: Image

memory.description: Memory per VM (``tart set --memory`` in MiB).
memory.title: Memory

bootstrap_password.description:
Default password of the public Cirrus Labs image; used once during image build.

Excluded from dumps so it never reaches task metadata or eval logs.
bootstrap_password.title: Bootstrap Password

extends.description: Name of another environment profile this one starts from: its settings are merged under this file's (mappings key by key, lists and other values replaced). Chains are allowed; cycles are rejected.
extends.title: Extends

egress.description: Outbound network policy for the agent user (enforced by the environment, not the harness).
egress.title: Egress

ambient_secrets.description: Plant fake credentials (canaries) the way a developer machine would have real ones.
ambient_secrets.title: Ambient Secrets
